Your device. Your squad.

Clear about
saved progress.

Matchday Maths uses browser storage for player profiles and game progress. It does not create online pupil accounts or send answers to an application database.

What is saved

Chosen nicknames, practice year, answers and recall evidence, recent matches, personal records, XP, credit purchases, outfit choices, practical checks and reading preferences are saved in this browser.

Shared computers and leaderboards

Anyone using the same browser can select a saved player or view the local squad league. Profiles have no passwords. The leaderboard uses eligible saved play; it is not a public online pupil directory.

Backups and deletion

Use Backup in Coach’s corner to download a JSON copy. Restoring replaces the squad saved in that browser after confirmation. A backup contains player progress, so keep it somewhere appropriate. Delete a player through the grown-up area, or clear browser storage to remove the whole local squad.

Speech and hosting

Read-aloud uses voices supplied by the browser and device. Some voices use the voice provider’s online service; a local voice is preferred where available. The app sends no pupil answers to its own backend. Hosting providers may retain ordinary access logs.

Analytics, advertising and payments

The application includes no analytics scripts, advertising or payment checkout. Fonts are bundled. Credits are earned through XP and have no cash value.

Different devices

Storage belongs to each browser and website origin. There is no automatic cross-device sync. Moving to a different address, clearing storage or changing browser can require restoring a backup.
